decisions.statement: A block is found by the key written in brackets and quotes.
A block runs from its key to the brace closing the block.
Braces are counted so a nested block does not end the outer block.
A block already there is replaced in place rather than moved.
A key absent is inserted before the first sibling key found.
Siblings are tried in the order the caller named the siblings.
Content no anchor is found in is handed back unchanged.
The indent is taken from the key's own line where the key is there.
The indent falls back to the line of the first sibling found.
The indent falls back to twelve spaces where no line is found.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: how one keyed block is replaced inside a saved-variables file the game wrote
